finding: Every warm bind of the same adaptive representation performs another shared-cache lookup/hit and provider table assignment. The warm adaptive bind is orders of magnitude more expensive than the analytical step-duration bind.
code_interpretation: The cache prevents table reconstruction but does not prevent repeated deep copying of allocatable representation arrays into the provider. This is avoidable lifecycle work.
repair: Retain the representation inside the provider when the exact representation key is unchanged; refresh only step-dependent analytical fallback binding. Preserve shared-cache behavior for a distinct provider or changed key.
nonclaims: This microbenchmark does not establish an application speedup.
The measured ratio is for bind overhead only.
